scope: Brand-independent stop/escalation guidance for suspect hazardous existing building materials encountered before sanding, scraping, drilling, cutting, demolition or other disturbance. This dataset does not establish Greek/EU legal duties and does not prescribe asbestos abatement methods.

rules.claim: A building material cannot be reliably determined to contain or not contain asbestos simply by visual inspection; laboratory testing is needed for certainty.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Δεν είναι ασφαλές να αποφασίσεις μόνο από την εμφάνιση ότι ένα παλιό δομικό υλικό δεν περιέχει αμίαντο. Αν πρόκειται να τριφτεί, κοπεί, τρυπηθεί, ξηλωθεί ή αλλιώς να διαταραχθεί και υπάρχει εύλογη υποψία, χρειάζεται κατάλληλη επαγγελματική αξιολόγηση πριν συνεχίσεις.
rules.stop_escalation: Stop automatic preparation/removal guidance when a suspect material would be disturbed and its asbestos status is unknown.

source.title: How do I know if I have asbestos in my home?

rules.applicability_note: The physical identification limitation is generalized. US-specific legal/accreditation requirements are not generalized to Greece.

rules.claim: Suspect asbestos-containing materials can release fibres when disturbed, damaged, cut, sanded, drilled, scraped or removed improperly; unnecessary disturbance should therefore be avoided pending competent assessment.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Αν ένα υλικό μπορεί να περιέχει αμίαντο, μην προχωράς σε τρίψιμο, ξύσιμο, τρύπημα, κοπή ή αποξήλωση ως συνηθισμένη προετοιμασία επιφάνειας. Η διατάραξη μπορεί να απελευθερώσει ίνες. Σταμάτησε και ζήτησε κατάλληλη αξιολόγηση πριν από εργασίες που θα το διαταράξουν.
rules.stop_escalation: Do not recommend ordinary DIY abrasive or demolition preparation for suspect asbestos-containing material.

source.title: Protect Your Family from Exposures to Asbestos

rules.applicability_note: Only the general exposure-prevention principle is used. Abatement technique and jurisdiction-specific compliance belong outside this Layer A rule.

rules.claim: Where suspect material is damaged or planned renovation will disturb it, EPA recommends sampling by a properly trained asbestos professional and analysis by a qualified laboratory rather than homeowner sampling.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Όταν ύποπτο υλικό είναι φθαρμένο ή πρόκειται να διαταραχθεί από την εργασία, η ασφαλής κατεύθυνση δεν είναι αυτοσχέδια δειγματοληψία. Χρειάζεται κατάλληλος επαγγελματίας για αξιολόγηση/δειγματοληψία και κατάλληλη εργαστηριακή ανάλυση, σύμφωνα με τις απαιτήσεις που ισχύουν στην Ελλάδα.
rules.stop_escalation: Escalate to an appropriately qualified local professional before disturbing suspect material. KONTA MOY must not instruct the customer how to take an asbestos sample.

source.title: I'm remodeling my home. Do I need to be concerned about asbestos in the building materials?

rules.applicability_note: The recommendation for trained sampling/laboratory analysis is retained as a conservative general safety principle. Exact professional qualifications and legal process must be verified for Greece/EU before jurisdiction-specific claims are displayed.

rules.claim: Suspect asbestos-containing material that is in good condition and will not be disturbed does not automatically require removal; disturbance itself can increase exposure risk.
rules.customer_guidance_el: Η πιθανή παρουσία αμιάντου δεν σημαίνει ότι πρέπει αυτομάτως να αφαιρεθεί το υλικό. Αν είναι σε καλή κατάσταση και δεν πρόκειται να διαταραχθεί, μην δημιουργείς νέα εργασία αποξήλωσης χωρίς κατάλληλη αξιολόγηση.
rules.stop_escalation: Do not turn suspicion alone into an automatic removal instruction. Escalate decisions about repair, encapsulation, enclosure or removal to competent local assessment where asbestos is confirmed or reasonably suspected.

source.title: Protect Your Family from Exposures to Asbestos

rules.applicability_note: No abatement method is selected by this rule. It prevents KONTA MOY from recommending unnecessary destructive preparation.

unresolved.question: What exact Greek/EU licensing, notification, sampling, worker-protection, transport and disposal requirements apply to asbestos work for each supported project type?
unresolved.reason: The reviewed evidence establishes hazard/assessment principles but US regulatory requirements must not be presented as Greek law. A separate Greece/EU regulatory verification pass is required.

unresolved.question: Can KONTA MOY use a building-age cutoff in Greece to determine that asbestos is absent or presumed present?
unresolved.reason: US OSHA pre-1981 presumptions are jurisdiction-specific and do not establish a safe Greek building-age rule. No universal cutoff is asserted.

unresolved.question: Which Greek building products/assemblies and eras should trigger an asbestos screening question in the customer workflow?
unresolved.reason: A Greece-specific authoritative evidence set is required before converting examples into a customer-facing screening matrix.

layer_boundary.note: Layer A establishes only general hazard-recognition and stop/escalation principles. It does not prescribe abatement, PPE, sampling technique, disposal, legal compliance, or product selection.
